headline: Nifty dips amid *heightened volatility*
hero_text: Fear surged with India VIX up 6.1%, while the broader market showed mixed movements.

why.title: Nifty Decline
why.desc: Nifty 50 fell 0.70% with no clear catalyst.

bonus_text: India VIX rose sharply by 6.1%, reflecting heightened market fear.
movers_note_gainers: Dr Reddy's and Bajaj Auto advanced.
movers_note_losers: Apollo Hospitals and ITC dragged the index.
watch_text: Tomorrow's Nifty 50 weekly options expiry adds potential volatility.
lessons: Nifty declined without a singular catalyst.
Volatility rose sharply, as seen in the VIX spike.
Divergent FII and DII flows highlighted market uncertainty.
Media sector gains stood out amid a mixed day.
alert_text: Nifty 50 weekly options expiry is set for tomorrow.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Watch for tomorrow's expiry.

Nifty fell 0.70% to 22,363.35 amid rising fear.
India VIX surged 6.1%, indicating heightened volatility.
Media led the gainers, rising 4.60%.
